SASBDB entry SASDWS5  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDWS5/)

Publication: A protein-dependent riboswitch activates ribosomal frameshifting in cardioviruses (Betts et al.; bioRxiv preprint consulted).
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.07.17.665365 (preprint)

The publisher's PDF is not kept here. The CORAL model SASDWS5_fit1_model1.pdb contains 29
dummy residues (UNK, one C-alpha each, the flexible N- and C-terminal extensions) that
BAYSOL cannot treat as atoms. SASDWS5_fit1_model1_atomistic.pdb is that file with exactly
those 29 'ATOM ... UNK' lines removed (1822 -> 1793 atoms, nothing else changed); the
original stays beside it and the script fits the cleaned one. 9RVP.pdb is the RCSB crystal
structure the model is derived from, kept for comparison, not fitted. The deposited
CRYSOL fit (SASDWS5_fit1.fit) includes the dummy atoms. Script: test/fitting_tests/SASDWS5/.
